universal_lens: Plate discipline quantified via expected run differential from swing vs. take decisions, leveraging xgboost-predicted outcomes and Statcast data. EAGLE quantifies expected run value from swing/take decisions via probabilistic outcome matrices, integrating plate discipline and pitch selection into a unified predictive framework.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference framework maps swing/take decisions to expected runs using xgboost models; conformal prediction ensures uncertainty quantification across pitch contexts. Bayesian inference models EAGLE as a posterior distribution over swing decisions, conditioning on observed pitch types and historical outcome probabilities for robust plate discipline estimation.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine encodes state transitions between pitch presentation and hitter action, modeling dynamic decision-making under probabilistic reward landscapes. Situational reasoning maps EAGLE to state transitions in hitter decision trees, where each pitch encounter updates internal belief states about optimal swing thresholds and risk-reward tradeoffs.
